rule: Every incorrect genuine MAYHEM tip triggers a forensic failure audit before its lessons may affect future decisions. The audit must distinguish pre-match analytical defects from post-kickoff events and must not rewrite the frozen decision.

audits.core_finding: The Eels selection remained at 62% even though the last captured pre-match checkpoint had already established that 62% exceeded the overround-adjusted market baseline by 4.31 percentage points without sufficient independent causal evidence. The T-60m record explicitly marked the decision REVIEW_REQUIRED and did not re-freeze it; the mandatory T-10m checkpoint was then MISSED_NOT_CAPTURED. The public tipping grade remains simply INCORRECT, while internally the process failure is that an unvalidated confidence state survived to kickoff instead of being reduced or held as unresolved.

pre_match_evidence.market: At T-60m, Sportsbet head-to-head was Dragons $2.25 / Eels $1.65. Removing overround produced Dragons 42.31% / Eels 57.69%. MAYHEM remained Eels 62%, an uplift of +4.31 percentage points.
roster: Dragons had no game-day change at the captured T-60m checkpoint.
Eels moved Sean Russell to fullback and Apa Twidle to the interchange shortly before kickoff.
The checkpoint correctly treated the Eels backfield reshuffle as uncertainty rather than a proven directional edge.
pre_match_evidence.weather: Mostly sunny and dry in Wollongong with west/southwesterly winds turning southerly; wind was classified as variance with no demonstrated team-specific edge.
pre_match_evidence.counter_case: The captured adversarial case identified Dragons home venue, unchanged game-day roster and the Eels backfield reshuffle as reasons the favourite did not deserve an unsupported uplift beyond normalized market probability.
pre_match_evidence.checkpoint_integrity: T-60m was captured late but before kickoff at 13:37:26 AEST. T-10m was MISSED_NOT_CAPTURED and is not retrospectively reconstructed.

failure_mechanisms.finding: The +4.31pp uplift above normalized market probability lacked the required independent causal football mechanism. The T-60m gate correctly detected this but the stored 62% confidence was not reduced before kickoff.
The latest captured pre-match state was REVIEW_REQUIRED. A review flag must prevent the same confidence from being treated as a fully validated MAYHEM freeze.

The mandatory T-10m checkpoint was MISSED_NOT_CAPTURED, so there was no final evidence/market/roster validation immediately before kickoff. This does not suppress the INCORRECT tip grade, but it materially reduces process assurance.
The T-60m record contained a credible Dragons counter-case but did not translate that counter-case into a confidence reduction despite the market-uplift gate already failing.

The T-60m record retained existing player dossiers but did not document the required role-critical statistical comparison after the Eels fullback reshuffle. A material late role change therefore entered the decision without a completed player-level comparison gate.

verified: Eels led 22-10 after Jordan Samrani's second try early in the second half.
Valentine Holmes left the field and Hamish Stewart failed a HIA for the Dragons.
Blake Lawrie was sin-binned in the 68th minute.
The Eels committed three consecutive errors before Connor Muhleisen's try levelled the scores 22-22.
Tyrell Sloan kicked a two-point field goal in the 75th minute for the decisive 24-22 lead.
post_match_validation.interpretation: The late injuries, sin-bin, errors and two-point field goal were post-kickoff events and are not backfilled into pre-match reasoning. Notably, several post-kickoff events disadvantaged the Dragons, so the result cannot be explained away as a single unforeseeable event against the Eels. The auditable pre-match defect remains the unsupported confidence uplift and unresolved validation state.

confidence_error.finding: At minimum, 4.31 percentage points of confidence required independent justification and did not receive it. This is a confidence-process error, not a claim that the market probability was the true ex ante probability.

mandatory_corrections: REVIEW_REQUIRED_HARD_GATE: if the latest pre-kickoff state is REVIEW_REQUIRED, no unchanged confidence may be represented internally as fully validated; reduce confidence to a supported level or preserve REVIEW_REQUIRED without validation claims.
UPLIFT_ENFORCEMENT: more than +3pp versus normalized two-sided market probability requires explicit independent evidence and causal mechanism in the same checkpoint record.
ROLE_CHANGE_STAT_GATE: a late change at fullback, halves, hooker or other role-critical position requires an explicit player-statistical comparison before directional confidence is retained.
ADVERSARIAL_ACTION_RULE: when the strongest opposing case and failed market-uplift gate point in the same direction, confidence must be reduced unless stronger independent evidence defeats that case.
T10_INTEGRITY: MISSED_NOT_CAPTURED remains immutable; no retrospective T-10 reconstruction is permitted.
TIP_GRADE_SEPARATION: the public ledger remains Eels 62% · INCORRECT; validation/calibration defects remain internal audit metadata only.
audits.integrity: No retrospective tip switch or probability rewrite. Eels 62% remains the genuine recorded selection and is graded INCORRECT. The failure audit changes future process only.

audits.core_finding: The 68% Cowboys confidence was not supported by the available evidence. MAYHEM stacked correlated consensus signals, failed to anchor on structural parity, and treated Canberra's debut-half uncertainty predominantly as downside instead of variance.

pre_match_evidence.market: Published head-to-head snapshots clustered around Cowboys $1.48-$1.55 and Raiders $2.45-$2.50. Removing bookmaker overround implies a Cowboys probability of roughly 61.7%-62.3%, materially below MAYHEM's 68%.
pre_match_evidence.structural_baseline: Official Round 27 ladder state showed Cowboys 13-10 with -64 point differential and Raiders 10-13 with -65 point differential: effectively identical season scoring differential despite the ladder gap.
raiders_context: Canberra entered off a Round 26 bye
Coby Black debuted at halfback after strong NSW Cup form
Raiders retained substantial senior forward experience including Papalii and Joe Tapine

failure_mechanisms.finding: MAYHEM set 68%, around six percentage points above the normalized market baseline, without independent evidence strong enough to justify the uplift.

Market price plus two model outputs were treated as multiple corroborating signals even though they may share common priors, market information or team-strength inputs. Consensus was mistaken for independence.
The Cowboys' finals position and home record were allowed to dominate a critical counter-signal: Cowboys and Raiders had almost identical season point differentials (-64 versus -65).
Nanai, Neame and Laybutt were all unavailable. The existing checkpoint acknowledged the attrition but did not reduce confidence enough relative to the structural baseline.
Coby Black's debut was used mainly as a Canberra weakness. The correct pre-match treatment was high uncertainty/variance because strong lower-grade performance created both downside and upside tails.
The decision record did not force a full Raiders-win case before freezing Cowboys. A MAYHEM decision must attempt to defeat its own preferred hypothesis before confidence is accepted.

verified: Coby Black scored 26 points on debut from two tries and nine goals.
Reuben Cotter was sin-binned in the opening passage after high contact on Josh Papalii.
post_match_validation.interpretation: The Cotter sin-bin was a post-kickoff event and cannot be used to claim the pre-match Raiders case was obvious. It is therefore excluded as a pre-match analytical defect. The larger failure remains that 68% confidence was unjustified before the game began.

mandatory_corrections: NORMALISE_MARKET: convert head-to-head prices to overround-adjusted implied probabilities before using market probability as a reference.
INDEPENDENCE_GRAPH: evidence from market-linked or shared-input models counts as one evidence family unless independence is established.
CONFIDENCE_JUSTIFICATION_GATE: any MAYHEM confidence more than 3 percentage points above the normalized market requires explicit independent evidence and a written causal mechanism.
STRUCTURAL_BASELINE_GATE: compare season point differential, recent scoring differential and venue split before narrative factors such as ladder position or finals status can increase confidence.
ROSTER_BURDEN_GATE: quantify directional roster losses by unit and replacement quality before home advantage is applied.
DEBUTANT_VARIANCE_RULE: debut/low-sample players expand uncertainty unless evidence supports a directional downgrade; novelty alone is not negative evidence.
ADVERSARIAL_INVERSION: before every freeze, construct the strongest evidence-supported case for the opposing selection and record what would falsify the preferred tip.
INCORRECT_TIP_HALT: after an incorrect genuine tip, the failure audit must be completed before learned weights are carried into later fixtures.
audits.integrity: No retrospective tip switch. Cowboys 68% remains frozen and incorrect. The audit changes future process, not the historical record.
